description: This file defines the `SageMakerRuntimeClient` class used to interact with the Amazon SageMaker Runtime service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various synchronous and asynchronous API calls related to SageMaker endpoints.

classes.name: SageMakerRuntimeClient
classes.description: A client class used to invoke SageMaker endpoints, capable of synchronous and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: invokeEndpointAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous invocation of an endpoint.

methods.name: invokeEndpointWithResponseStream
methods.description: Invokes an endpoint that streams response data.

methods.name: invokeEndpointWithResponseStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes an endpoint that streams response data.
